title: नाइट शिफ्ट का खौफ: 13वीं मंजिल का बंद केबिन 😱 | AI Horror Movie
description:
रात के 12 बजे जब पूरी टेक पार्क खाली हो जाती है, तब 13वीं मंजिल पर काम करना एक बुरा सपना बन जाता है।
रोहन अकेला नाइट शिफ्ट में अपने अर्जेंट प्रोजेक्ट पर काम कर रहा था।
अचानक खाली केबिन से कीबोर्ड की तेजी से बजने की आवाजें आने लगती हैं।
क्या रोहन वहां अकेला था, या मॉनिटर की काली स्क्रीन के पीछे कोई और खड़ा था?
जानिए इस रौंगटे खड़े कर देने वाली हॉरर कहानी में!
#HindiHorrorStory #AIHorrorMovie #NightShiftHorror #HorrorKahani #UrbanHorror #ScaryStories

chapters: Late Night Overtime: Rohan stays back past midnight on the empty 13th floor of a tech park to finish an urgent project.
The Cold Cup: Rohan finds a steaming hot coffee cup placed on a workstation desk that has been locked for five years.
Typing in the Dark: Mysterious heavy keyboard typing noises resonate from the dark, unlit corner of Cabin 13.
CCTV Warning: Meera from the security control room calls Rohan in panic, saying the CCTV shows a shadowy figure standing right behind him.
Power Outage: A sudden electrical glitch cuts the floor lights and locks the automatic glass doors, trapping Rohan inside.
The Monitor Reflection: Rohan uses his phone flashlight and spots a dark burnt silhouette reflection staring at him from his computer screen.
Archived Truth: Rohan accesses an old digital archive and discovers a tragic night-shift fire accident in Cabin 13 from twenty years ago.
The Stairwell Trap: Rohan reaches the emergency fire exit door, but the handle turns by itself from the outside as the chapter ends on a cliffhanger.
recap: Rohan gets locked inside an empty 13th-floor office building during his late-night shift while being hunted by an entity from a past fire accident. He barely manages to reach the emergency stairwell, only to find the door handles moving on their own.
